system.notes: No recruiting board will hear her now: the surgeons' report stays on her file for life.
system.biography: Raised in the spin-light quarters above the orbital yards, she came down to Bellweather's gravity at eighteen with bones that never forgave it, and the Reach Guard's signals watch took her for her head. A dispatch won her commission in the first term, and evidence given against her own captain helped the climb to Lord Warden. In her fifth term her legs folded under her on the watch floor; the council's surgeons stood her up again at a price, and she has taken the longevity drugs since. She retired on a pension that barely dents what she owes.

demo.cliff: a commission moves the record onto the ladder its assignment names
teaches: Three assignments share one enlisted ladder and one officer ladder, each named by id: ladder is the one entered on, officerLadder the one a commission moves to. The officer ladder carries officer: true, or the template reports it.

commission: true and commissionCheck add the commission step: a pass puts the record at rank 1 of the officer ladder and pays that rung's bonus at once. After the first term the roll needs SOC 9+ and takes DM-1 for each term served.
tables.officer is requiresCommission: it is offered only to a Traveller on the officer ladder, beside the three tables everyone rolls on.

Forced out by advancement is not a field: an Advancement total at or under the terms served in this career ends it, and the record closes as forcedOutByAdvancement. Row 4's DM-2 makes that likelier, and a natural 12 is the opposite: the Traveller must stay.
basicFrom: assignment takes basic training from the assignment's own table rather than Service Skills, so a picket hand and a signaller start with different skills.
assignmentChange: requalifyKeepRank makes a new assignment a fresh Qualification roll, the age DM included: a pass keeps the rank, a failure keeps the old assignment.
Row 9's throw is keyed to the assignment: each of the three is offered its own skill and target, and nobody is asked which.
pensionable pays a pension to a Traveller who leaves after five terms or more, and medicalBillsRow: military pays the largest share of an injury's care.

Row 3 ejects only a Traveller who refuses its question and row 2 lets the mishap it rolls decide. Mishap 2 ejects but keeps the term's Benefit roll, which a failed Survival roll would otherwise cost; mishap 3 injures an associate rather than the Traveller, and mishap 4 ejects only on a failed check.
demo.trap: The officer ladder starts at rank 1 and has no rank 0, because a commission enters it at rank 1 and pays that rung's bonus. exitRule.track stays blank, and must for a forced exit to happen: a career with a leaving track reads the Advancement total against that track instead. standingModifiers and tracks stay empty because the Guard prints no footnote and no track. The eleven record fields below the tables stay empty, as on every template.

system.description: Bellweather's system-defence service: the picket boats on the Reach, the orbital gun platforms, and the signals watch that ties them to the quay. It commissions officers onto a ladder of their own, pays a pension after a long service, and covers most of an injury's care. Invented for this pack, and no book's career.

bonus.text: A Patron on the Reach council

eventTable.text: A picket boat breaks up on the outer buoys with you aboard. Take a roll on the Mishap table; that row decides whether you stay.
A board of inquiry sits over a boat lost on your watch. Give evidence against your captain, and gain an Enemy and DM+2 held for your next Advancement roll; refuse, and the Guard lets you go.

tray.note: Your evidence is noted: DM+2 held for one Advancement roll.

eventTable.text: A live-fire drill on the outer buoys hits the wrong buoy. Gain one level of Gunner, and carry DM-2 into your next Advancement roll.

tray.note: The drill is remembered: DM-2 on one Advancement roll, which brings a total at or under your terms served closer.

eventTable.text: The Guard sends you up to the orbital yard for a season of courses. Make an EDU check (8+): pass, and gain one level in a skill you already hold.

grant.text: One level in a skill you hold

eventTable.text: Your captain mentions you in a dispatch to the Reach council. Gain one level of Tactics or Leadership, and DM+2 held for your next Commission or Advancement roll, whichever comes first.

tray.note: The dispatch: DM+2 held for one Commission or Advancement roll, spent by the first of them.

eventTable.text: Life Event: the shared Life Events table answers this one.
A harbour patrol captain who served beside you on the Reach asks for you by name. Gain a Contact; if you leave, the patrol takes you at your next qualification with no roll.

A freighter drifts into the exclusion zone with its transponder dark. Turn it back with Pilot (8+) on the picket boats, Gunner (9+) on the platforms or Electronics (7+) on the watch: succeed, and gain a Contact and DM+1 held for your next Advancement roll; fail, and its master becomes a Rival.

tray.note: The freighter turned back: DM+1 held for one Advancement roll.

eventTable.text: You are seconded to the mainland signals school for a season. Gain one level of Electronics, and one extra roll on a skill table this term.
The Lord Warden reads your file twice. Your next Commission or Advancement roll passes without dice, when you choose to spend it.

tray.note: The Lord Warden's notice: one Commission or Advancement roll passes without dice, on the holder's word.

eventTable.text: You hold the gap in the picket line alone through a solar storm. Take a promotion, or a commission if you do not yet hold one.

mishapTable.text: A turret capacitor lets go beside you. Two throws on the Injury table, the worse one counts, and the Guard discharges you.
The signals logs you kept go missing before an audit. Gain an Enemy in Reach command and leave the Guard, though the board lets you keep this term's Benefit roll.
A misfire on the gunnery range hurts the loader beside you. The loader rolls on the Injury table and holds you to blame as a Rival; you are sent home.
The Reach council cuts the picket budget. Make a Leadership or Admin check (8+) to keep a berth on what remains; fail, and you leave.
Eleven weeks adrift in a crippled boat. Lose 1 END and leave the Guard.
A hull breach on a boarding drill. One throw on the Injury table; the Guard keeps you on.

demo.cliff: an ageing crisis is paid for on the sheet and not in the term, and a pension waits for the finish
teaches: A score aged to 0 stops nothing: the loop only announces the crisis, and the care is a row added on the Health tab, which this run presses. STR stands at 1 and the rolled price is a row of characteristicLog.
Only ChargenClose.finish banks finance.pension and settles finance.debt. Here the Cash covers a part of what the care and the anagathics cost, so the rest goes into play as debt.
demo.trap: states.ageingCrisis stays true after the care, because the row that reduced the score is still in the log: Hesper reads STR 1, fails the Qualification roll of any later career, and fails any change of assignment that needs one. finance.pension is 14,000 and not the career's 12,000, because this system reads the Cr1,000 a year an unused Ship Share pays as a sum per share, and she holds two.
